verdict.rationale: Unity's docs confirm headless Editor/Player execution via command-line arguments (-batchmode, -nographics) and a CLI/Build Automation stack explicitly designed for CI pipelines (unity-docs-6/7/8/25/26/28, unity-probe-rt-3/4), which is the infrastructure needed to run code in CI against the real engine. But no evidence specifically documents the Unity Test Framework or a -runTests/-testResults flag executing unit/integration tests headlessly — only general 'headless mode' and 'CI/build automation' claims are present. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Test Runner / -runTests CLI flag for executing unit and integration tests in batch mode, and independent/community confirmation that this works reliably in CI.
